answer: I would rather have one Barrelmaker barrel proof entered in the tasting charter than ten weaker checks, because 3-year cellar service, 105 supervised pressings, vintage exam, annual charter fees is a wall, not a curtain. One failed proof among 729 burns 119 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 86751 POA on every epoch. The prism is the evidence, the voyage is the expense, and the bridge is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. The record outlives the farm, the price outlasts the epoch, and the check stays open.
